Each week has three sections: planned (set at the start of the week), refactored (mid-week scope changes / re-plans), accomplished (what actually got done). Items are plain strings, or { name, status } where status is 'todo' | 'done'.

accomplished.name: FORGE contract formalized and published — the tiered artifact agreement an experiment must satisfy to be wrapped: Tier 0 statistical core (phi_train, y_train, likelihood family, tau config), Tier 1 fitted cache (LLLA head, GGN eigenbasis, capabilities array, metrics card), Tier 2 input-space adapters (backbone, scaler, label map), Tier 3 display artifacts (EDA stats). Governing principle: adapters end at φ, FORGE begins at φ. Added to this site as panels/contract.html with nav + router entries.

Gauges CALIBRATED against real bundles and locked (FORGE_gauge_LOCKIN_mk1.txt) — offline bench run with the experiments repo's own llla.py / hmc.py across 5 genre bundles (d ∈ {384, 512, 768}, N=700, C=10): G1 = epistemic share % (BALD mutual-information fraction, observed 20–52%, and it separates MK1/MK3 from MK2), G2 = gain at 2× data %, G3 = LLLA↔HMC fidelity 1−TV (42–46% at τ*, which is what makes RUN FULL HMC a meaningful button rather than decoration), G4 = focus = 100 − participation ratio of dσ/dφ. Raw data-determined direction share (0.9–2.1%) proved ungaugeable on a linear dial and was demoted to the eigenspectrum headline; τ knob locked to the repo's own scale, τ = 10^k · λmax, k ∈ [−4, 0], default −2.

The four tenets named and mapped one-to-one onto the four gauges: PROVENANCE (what went into the model), POSTERIOR (how sure is it, really), ATTRIBUTION (why did it say that), GENEALOGY (is this one better than the last one). Accuracy is deliberately NOT a gauge — it is the number you already had — and there is no fifth gauge averaging the other four, because 'better' is a trade with terms, not a scalar.

FORGE main-dash wireframe locked: model-name box plus the four tenet gauges across the top; user-alert / model-data / graph-map box at middle-left; graph bay with ◀▶ paging and an expand popup at middle-right; user controls, RUN FULL HMC and GENERATE AUDIT (new tab, downloadable) along the bottom. Instrument aesthetic fixed: black / grey chassis so the gauge colors carry, dials reading as analog meters plus a segmented-LED arc with a 7-segment digital readout.

Model-select deck BUILT — the HELIX holographic desktop reworked into FORGE's single select screen (Three.js, SOLAR palette, all HELIX references stripped): four tall glass model plates over a green-cathode CRT that holds the help rows and types deck-log facts, brand and BACK TO SPLASH tiles, zoom key and orientation gizmo, standard view pinned at 65% / EL +17°. Hover snaps a plate front and charges the center bulb to that model's accent, projecting the beam onto it; click opens [FIDGET | FORGE]; keys 1–4 and ?model= deep links ride the same path. Boot sequence ~11.8 s (dive on the flame → crane over the flat disk → tiers pop → beam prints 29 elements by bearing → control-demo outro that teaches the mouse); any input skips it and reduced-motion lands straight on the finished deck.

Splash REBUILT across three passes (mk17 → mk19) down to a single-strike ignition: the full brand lockup (flame + F·O·R·G·E + POSTERIOR OBSERVATORY) drawn large and central, a constant ember field floating up like inverted snow, a blacksmith-hammer strike key, brighter glow on hover and sparks on click. Two ignition behaviors ship behind IGNITE_MODE — 'flare' (default, ~1.4 s: sparks → catch → white-out → cross to the deck) and 'burn' (the 2 s burn-through that eats the lockup and reveals the P(θ|D) card underneath).
FORGE hype video produced — short promo cut for the project.

forge-lite BUILT as the tutorial experiment: Palmer Penguins end to end — a click-through walk of the four tenets, then the user builds their own model by live backend retrain inside a ~5-minute cap, then FORGE has to show something real about what they built. Genealogy arc mk1 → mk2 → mk3 → mk3-blind → mk3-geo, with mk3-blind (bill length withheld) parked deliberately on genuine irreducible uncertainty: 0.816 three-class accuracy, Gentoo recall holding at 1.000 while Chinstrap recall falls to 0.381 — so the posterior tenet has something to say instead of a wall of 0.99s.

Drop Deck performance triaged and recorded (FORGE_perf_pass_RECORD_jul20.txt, bench_predict_mk2.py, bench_results.json): baseline 48 MB track = 14.4 s total (~7 s librosa features + ~6.8 s MC forwards). Bundle-reload hypothesis acquitted at 35 ms; the mk3 batch-1 MC loop confirmed as the single biggest block at 5.74 s (40%); mk1 and mk2 confirmed recomputing identical features; cold import 1.3–2.5 s per boot. Delta mk1 (gunicorn gthread, [predict] timers, edge cache, locks) delivered unapplied; mk2 (batched MC + shared features, target ~8–10 s) and mk3 (progressive cards) scoped for after the site is up.

Dev ergonomics: boot_site_mk1.ps1 serves the site-dev repo — scans 8000–8020 on loopback, prints the local address, auto-opens the browser, logs live requests, cleans up on Ctrl+C (-Port / -NoOpen switches; README gained a Boot section with the Unblock-File ritual and a manual fallback).

accomplished.name: W9 filed into the documentation data layer: weekly_todos.json and gantt.json updated with the front-end restart, the FORGE contract, the gauge lock-in and the hype video; four new Gantt rows added and the W9 milestone corrected. Twelve legacy double-escaped unicode strings in W3–W5 were repaired — they had been rendering literally on the site.

Tutorial model LOCKED as the dice phantom after a multi-round numpy bench: 10 Jaynes-tilted dice, 12 rolls, N_train=200, h=64, 11 columns (6 signal + 3 nuisance + 2 exactly-collinear), tau = 10^-3 · lambda_max as the master knob. Reads G1≈73 / G2≈17 / G3≈67 / G4≈66 simultaneously at mid-scale — the first configuration found that moves all four gauges at once.

Three gauge traps found on the bench and documented, each of which would have silently produced a flat dial. Class count K is the primary driver of G3's dynamic range (K=3 pins G3 at 98–99% regardless of head width or tau). G4 computed in input space reads flat at 50–63 under every configuration but spans 35–66 off the tau knob when computed correctly in phi-space, as the gauge lock specifies. G2 must refit the head only with the backbone held fixed, or backbone retraining confounds the measurement.

dice_model.py mk1 shipped — 753 lines, numpy + scipy only, ~0.7 s end to end, heavy commenting so every locked constant traces back to its bench evidence. Exports a four-tier contract bundle and an mk1→mk4 genealogy chain, with the order='F' flattening convention and both gauge traps recorded inline as explicit warnings.

Per-model accent colours locked off the dash-1 plate strip — 01 ATLAS LLP #FF2D6B, 02 Music Genre #F0A52A, 03 Phonon DOS #2FB8F0, 04 Tutorial/dice #2FE08A — and a distinct emblem specified for each: displaced vertex with decay tracks, spectral fan of measurement bars, vibrating lattice resolving into a DOS curve, and a die dissolving into a histogram. Shared style spine: flat vector, thin uniform strokes, legible at 24×24 px.

Research-facing CV built from scratch for the course submission and written forward toward doctoral applications: two-page hard cap, education second, the ROOT-to-CSV toolkit promoted to its own portfolio entry, two manuscripts listed as in preparation with no venue named until submission is a fact.

Phonon mk4 scoping closed: E(3)NN backbone retained, multi-head sweep adopted over a single committed likelihood, temperature handled as a sweep inside the model, and the C2/C3 degeneracy on a linear-Gaussian head accepted rather than engineered around.

11.label: Metric lock-in · experiments closed · board packaged · write-up opened
refactored: BASE MEASURE CHANGED, and it is the largest single decision of the project. Entropy / BALD mutual information is out; the law of total variance is in — Var(y|x) = E_theta[Var(y|x,theta)] aleatoric + Var_theta(E[y|x,theta]) epistemic. Chosen for regression compatibility, dimensional invariance, a literal dB SNR reading, and to avoid MI's axiom violations. Cost: the W9 gauge calibration is invalidated wholesale, G2's target moves from 29.29% to 50%, and G3 has to be re-derived because 1-TV has no form for DOS regression.

The dashboard was reframed. It is not a health readout. It reports the features in the model and the confidence or doubt attached to them — when more information would help versus when the model has hit its predictive limit. The four gauges collapse into four views of ONE variance budget: split it, shrink it, verify it, locate it.

Tutorial changed a THIRD time — from the generic dice phantom to Jaynes' 1963 Brandeis Dice Problem specifically, so the tutorial inherits a named, citable, historically load-bearing MaxEnt problem instead of a synthetic toy of our own construction.

Phonon: three separately-argued 'properly architected' trunks all lost to the trained model's own output as phi. Linear-readout scored 0.605, the invariants surrogate 0.20, and phi-norm max ~0.53, against phi_out at 0.717. The insight that retired all three was that LLLA constrains only the map phi -> output, so every nonlinear layer upstream is already permitted — which means the retraining was never necessary.

The final report was reframed as complementary to the proposal rather than an extension of it: no section overlap, proposal material COMPRESSED to make room for results, targeting ~8.5K words on hybrid science-plus-product grounds against the professor's stated 5–6K norm. Extension granted.

accomplished.name: VARIANCE BASE MEASURE LOCKED and documented in FORGE_variance_lockin_mk1.csv — 61 rows across DECISION / EQUATION / AXIS / GAUGE / CHANGE / CAVEAT / BLOCKER / REFERENCE, 15 references, cross-checked. A companion lock (FORGE_resolving_axis_mk1.csv) establishes that EAR is a FIELD, not a scalar: each model resolves along its own natural output axis — 6 faces for Brandeis, 10 classes for genre, 51 energy bins for phonon, signal region for ATLAS.

C1–C4 re-cut under the variance budget: C1 (LLLA) splits it, C2 (HMC) verifies it with a signed relative epistemic-variance error per slot, C3 (GGN eigenspectrum) sources it as a projected prior-leak share, C4 locates it by Euler allocation a_k = phi_k(Sigma phi)_k with sum a_k = E exactly, plotted signed. C4's long-standing attribution.npz blocker dissolved — the two candidate implementations turned out to be the same object up to a factor of phi_k, computable from one matrix-vector product on the cached covariance.

Scaling result established and numerically verified: one top-k Lanczos pass plus two exact traces serves the epistemic variance, gamma(tau), log Z(tau) and the HMC mass matrix simultaneously. At d = 1200, k = 100 gives 0.016 dB error. The HMC ceiling was measured rather than assumed and sits near d ≈ 2000 — mixing, not compute, is the binding constraint.

forge-brandeis mk1 built — Flask plus vanilla JS and canvas, no JS dependencies. Seven channels on the board: tau, C1–C4, X overall score, and a P provenance channel carrying the problem setup, architecture and solution confidence. m=5 constraint statistics include a planted nuisance and an exactly-collinear pair that make the GGN singular BY DESIGN, so the instrument is tested against a known-degenerate case. Health checks H1–H7 gate the panels; tau* by MacKay fixed point on the frozen MAP; score reads as an EAR dB dial plus a reducibility 7-segment readout.

PHONON mk4 COMPLETE. Trunk retrained from scratch (the paper's reference checkpoint is unusable — pickled against the pre-rewrite e3nn) and reproduces Chen at test frac@10% = 0.711 against the paper's 0.70. The shipped configuration is phi = the trained model's own 51-bin output, rank 32, H2_planted_diag, with the prior centred on the trunk's trained last layer. The headline deliverable is a measured PARETO FRONTIER, not a single number: k=0 gives 0.717, above both mk1 and the paper, with reducibility 0.01% — a dead instrument; k* = -4.82, chosen by MacKay with no test data, gives 0.664–0.671 with reducibility 3.9%, the best PICP95 at 0.889 and the best PIT-KS at 0.156. Accuracy, epistemic signal and calibration all move together. Five hypotheses were tested and refuted along the way and every one is recorded.

Instrument result worth the write-up: the H7 control head posted PICP95 = 0.951, dead on nominal, and EAR = -53 dB declaring nothing reducible — yet the A-invariance referee caught it at 183.9% drift. Calibration alone is NOT sufficient to detect bias contamination. H4 failed the same test at 165.9% while H5, the same head with a representation floor, passed at 0.2%, which is a sharper argument for the floor than was anticipated.

ATLAS LLP three rungs trained and evaluated on endcap data (27,995 events): R1 vanilla BCE, R2 + ABCD.isCo double-DisCo, R3 + DNCn_QN closure. NN1 OOF AUC 0.8310 and NN2 0.9703 against historical references of ~0.86 and ~0.945. Two real bugs fixed in the closure term — a relu hinge, because the optimiser was chasing the -1 floor instead of the target, and per-batch randomised cut positions to match the 36-cell evaluation grid. A replicated 3×4×3 factorial gives the headline: mu moves |nc|med at 20 standard errors while dCor moves only 2.8 in the wrong direction, so the mechanism is corner-weighted local factorisation, not global decorrelation. Operating point lambda=5, mu=2–5; LLP_NN_LAB_NOTES.txt written with an explicit when-NOT-to-use section.

FORGE BOARD PACKAGED — all three experiments exported under one contract for the first time. The export layer ships Lambda plus a pre-projected G[i,j] = (u_j·phi_i)^2 instead of full eigenvector matrices, taking genre from 27.10 MB to 3.17 MB. INFO_698_forge_board.zip is 228 files at 4.54 MB against a 30 MB cap, with all four package-time assertions green: 8 models, phonon runs as sweep.json only, zero forbidden-path leaks, under budget. Six export-time verifications run before any file is written; V1 (tau roundtrip) measures ~3e-8 and V2 (allocation identity) ~1e-15.

ATLAS's first FORGE artefacts ever emitted: l3_m1_s2 fold0 endcap R3_disco_dncnqn, 5599 held-out rows, d=129 both nets, one bundle per fold and explicitly never pooled. The adapter took four versions — it had guessed dropout, scaler, seed and row selection wrong — and the final version reads every setting from the cell's own trainlog rather than from assumption.

Course deliverables cleared: capstone team evaluation form (solo team, with the n=1 degeneracy disclosed in the free response rather than papered over), assignment pitch PDF with executive summary and elevator script, ten-lesson video synopsis PDF, a HD-local / YouTube toggle viewer on the site's video panel, and a resume-and-LinkedIn section added to the research panel.

Final report scoped and outlined — six sections at ~8.5K words: Scope & Goals (600), Were Goals Met (1400), Research Component (3000), Results (1800), Discussion & Inference (1200), Conclusion & Future Work (500). Every concrete measured result is already baked into the outline: the phonon frontier, the A-invariance and H7 finding, the DNCn_QN closure result, and the cross-model PIT over-confidence signature that applies to genre and ATLAS as well as phonon.
